name: poststack
description: Self-hosted, source-available social media management for Facebook & Instagram — publish & schedule posts, auto-reply to DMs and comments, and run drip sequences from one place.

scripts.verify:local: npm ci && playwright install chromium && env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$HOME" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" E2E_PORT="${E2E_PORT:-3397}" CAPTCHA_E2E_PORT="${CAPTCHA_E2E_PORT:-3398}" PG_PORT="${E2E_PG_PORT:-55479}" E2E_SCREENSHOT="${E2E_SCREENSHOT:-/private/tmp/poststack-verify.png}" npm run verify:run
scripts.verify:run: sh -c 'set -eu; export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=poststack-verify-$$ POSTGRES_USER=test POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test POSTGRES_DB=test; export E2E_ADMIN_DATABASE_URL="postgres://test:test@127.0.0.1:$PG_PORT/test" E2E_DATABASE_URL="postgres://test:test@127.0.0.1:$PG_PORT/poststack_e2e"; trap "docker compose --env-file /dev/null down --volumes" EXIT; trap "exit 130" INT; trap "exit 143" TERM; docker compose --env-file /dev/null up -d --wait postgres; npm run test:e2e -- sections.spec.ts --project=chromium; npm test -- src/lib/auth; TEST_DATABASE_URL="$E2E_DATABASE_URL" npm run test:integration -- src/server/ui/sections'
